Name: PPJA Redux - For DGA
Author: paradigmnomad
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/ng2OErY.png[/img]
Almost the entire PPJA collection in one slightly confusing hub. Now with 100% less JA.

See a (nearly) full list of changes [url=https://gist.github.com/paradigmnomad/99f2d5f689e5310eb8b9cab38c40a5f6]here[/url].

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Eqdpuvd.png[/img]

Lots of things but you will need:
- Latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9365]Dynamic Game Assets[/url]
- Latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore[/url]
- Latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
- Latest version of Mail Framework Mod
- Latest version of Producer Framework Mod

If you're installing [b]Cannabis Kit[/b] you'll also need;[b]
[/b]- Latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6577]Hybrid Crop Engine[/url]

If you're unsure of what to install, install everything listed above. [b]Read the file descriptions[/b] to know what dependencies are required or check the old mod pages.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/LKwk9jp.png[/img]

Q: Some mods aren't updated yet, can I use this mod?
A: For the most part - yes. If you want to wait to update until all of the dependency mods are updated that's okay too.

Q: Did you test this mod?
A: Well, it won't crash your game on launch. Report bugs on GitHub and I may check it to fix them.

Q: Where did some of the optional files go?
A: I'll put them up as authors release DGA compatible versions such as "Miller Time" and "Custom Crafting Stations" add-ons if an update is needed.

Q: Why did you put them all in one file?
A: Easier. This does mean your old PPJA files that use Json Assets will not alert you for updates. These should be removed if you install the DGA versions. Each DGA file has an [ID]@[Name] for the update key for the specific pack. You don't need to update every single pack if you get an update alert for one pack.

Q: Didn't you retire?
A: Yes. I was briefly brought out of retirement to update PPJA to DGA so people can still continue to use it. Now I retreat back into retirement. Pathoschild still has taken over my mods. As mods like PFM and MFM update somebody will make sure they are updated to their new formats, assuming there are format changes.

Step 1. Install the dependencies listed under "You Will Need" section
Step 2. Download whichever packs you'd like from this mod and extract the zip file anywhere you would like.
Step 3. Drag & Drop the extracted folder(s) directly into the /Mods folder.

- Remove the corresponding pack from your `/Mods` folder
